item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Expand Funko Collab With Saja Boys Blind Box and Worldwide Chase
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, K-Pop fans and collectors! If you're obsessed with HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys, you're in luck. Funko has just released a new line of vinyl figures featuring your favorite characters, and we've got the scoop.
[Sound effects: Upbeat music continues]
Host: "You can now get your hands on figures of Jinu, Rumi, and even Derpy, available at Walmart and Amazon. Prices vary, but you can score some great deals on multi-buy savings. And, if you're feeling lucky, you can try your hand at the new blind box mystery figures.
[Sound effects: Mystery sound effect]
Host: "Each blind box contains one figurine, either one of the five Saja Boys or Crying Demon. And, if you're really lucky, you might just score the 1-in-72 Limited Edition Mystery Chase or the ultra-rare 1-in-1 Worldwide Chase. That's right, only one of these figures exists!
[Sound effects: Exciting music]
Host: "Amazon is offering pre-orders for the blind box Funk Pop! 'KPop Demon Hunters' Saja Boys Blind Box for just $14.99. And, if you're looking to complete your collection, you can snag a set of three figures featuring Rumi, Mira, and Zoey for just $55. That's 14% off the original price.
[Sound effects: Cash register sound]
Host: "Individual figures, like Jinu, are also available for purchase. Each character is made of sturdy vinyl and features their movie-accurate costumes. These figures make a great gift for collectors and superfans, and they're perfect for adding a touch of personality to any space.
[Sound effects: Upbeat music continues]
Host: "And, as a bonus, you can even create your own custom Funko figure through the Pop! Yourself option on Funko's website. Pricing varies depending on your choices, but it's a fun way to make your collection truly unique.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, what are you waiting for? Get ready to take down your collection with these amazing new Funko figures. Happy collecting, and thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
